mapper.select: SELECT id, model, version, basis, input_price, output_price, currency, effective_at FROM ai_price WHERE model = #{model} AND effective_at <= clock_timestamp() ORDER BY effective_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT model, version, basis, input_price, output_price, currency, effective_at FROM ai_price ORDER BY effective_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_price(model, version, basis, input_price, output_price, currency) VALUES (#{price.model}, #{price.version}, #{price.basis}, #{price.inputPrice}, #{price.outputPrice}, 'CNY')
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.department_id, m.conversation_id, m.id AS message_id FROM chat_message m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.request_id = #{requestId} AND m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage(request_id, trace_id, call_id, user_id, department_id, conversation_id, message_id, stage, provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, units, latency_ms, success, error_code, price_id, price_version, estimated_cost) VALUES (#{call.requestId}, #{call.traceId}, #{call.callId}, #{call.identity.userId}, #{call.identity.departmentId}, #{call.identity.conversationId}, #{call.identity.messageId}, #{call.stage}, 'DASHSCOPE', #{call.model}, #{call.inputTokens}, #{call.outputTokens}, #{call.units}, #{call.latencyMs}, #{call.success}, #{call.errorCode}, #{priceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{priceVersion}, #{call.cost}) ON CONFLICT (request_id, stage, call_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND (CAST(#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS bigint) IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS calls, coalesce(max(id), 0) AS last_id, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, sum(estimated_cost) AS estimated_cost, count(*) FILTER(WHERE estimated_cost IS NULL) AS unpriced_calls, count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT success) AS errors, coalesce(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY latency_ms), 0) AS p95_ms FROM ai_usage

SELECT
stage
model
to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS label, count(*) AS calls, sum(estimated_cost) AS estimated_cost, count(*) FILTER(WHERE estimated_cost IS NULL) AS unpriced_calls, count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT success) AS errors, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM ai_usage
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT route AS label, count(*) AS requests, count(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS errors, count(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled, count(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS running, count(*) FILTER(WHERE cache_hit) AS cache_hits, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER(WHERE status <> 'RUNNING') AS p95_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY first_token_ms) AS first_token_p95_ms FROM rag_request_trace
GROUP BY route ORDER BY route
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_request_trace(request_id, trace_id, message_id, user_id, department_id) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{departmentId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_request_trace SET route = #{route}, reason_code = #{reason}, status = #{status}, latency_ms = #{latency}, first_token_ms = #{first} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE estimated_cost IS NULL) = 0 THEN sum(estimated_cost) END AS cost, count(*) FILTER(WHERE estimated_cost IS NULL) AS unpriced_calls, count(*) AS calls FROM ai_usage WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
